# Next.js Project with Redux, Recharts, Mantine, and Framer Motion

This is a Next.js project configured with:
- Redux for state management
- Recharts for data visualization
- Mantine for UI components
- Framer Motion for animations

## Development Guidelines

When working on this project:
- Use TypeScript for all new files
- Follow the established folder structure in src/
- Use Redux Toolkit for state management
- Leverage Mantine components for UI elements
- Apply Framer Motion for smooth animations
- Use Recharts for data visualizations
- Follow Next.js App Router patterns

## Available Scripts
- `npm run dev` - Development server
- `npm run build` - Production build
- `npm run start` - Production server
- `npm run lint` - Code linting
